description: Generate the SNAPDELIVER_AUDIT_REPORT.md at root with comprehensive system audit covering env variable map, API bottleneck check, upload flow verification, and vector search check.
steps: Create SNAPDELIVER_AUDIT_REPORT.md at project root with the following sections:
Section 1 - Environment Variable Map: Complete checklist of every .env variable required across all apps (api, worker, web, desktop) with descriptions and which service uses each

Section 2 - API Bottleneck Check: Confirmation that NestJS main thread only dispatches jobs via BullMQ and never processes images or runs InsightFace. Reference specific files that prove this (apps/api/src/jobs/jobs.service.ts dispatches, apps/worker processes)

Section 3 - Upload Flow Verification: Step-by-step flow: Tauri app -> API (get presigned URLs) -> direct R2 upload (no bytes through API). Reference: apps/desktop/src/lib/chunked-uploader.ts, apps/api/src/uploads/uploads.service.ts

Section 4 - Vector Search Check: Confirmation that pgvector extension is enabled, migration creates vector(512) column, and search_wedding_photos RPC function uses cosine similarity operator (<=>). Reference migration files.
Section 5 - Architecture Diagram: ASCII art showing data flow between all services
Section 6 - Nepal Market Optimizations: Document offline-first queue, color neutralization for party palaces, and mobile-first portal with native share
acceptance_criteria: Contains all 4 required audit sections plus architecture and Nepal-specific optimizations
Environment variable map lists every variable from .env.example with service ownership
Upload flow section clearly shows bytes go directly to R2, not through API
Vector search section references the actual migration file and function name
verification: Verify SNAPDELIVER_AUDIT_REPORT.md exists and contains all required sections
Verify env var map matches .env.example contents
findings: Generated 413-line audit report covering all 6 sections. Verified all file references are accurate against actual source code. No build/test verification needed for docs-only change.
